subject: literacy
concept: Combining several related sentences into a short paragraph
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges sentence-strip tiles about the same topic into a logical short paragraph
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which sentence doesn't belong in a short paragraph about one topic
exercise.abstract: Student writes 3-4 related sentences forming a short paragraph on a given topic

misconception_flags: includes an unrelated sentence that breaks the paragraph's topic

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
